name: dsh-browser
description: Standalone dsh browser bridge and Chrome extension workspace

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-bridge-browser run build && pnpm --filter dsh-browser-extension run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-bridge-browser run test && pnpm --filter dsh-browser-extension run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-bridge-browser run typecheck && pnpm --filter dsh-browser-extension run typecheck
